602 likes, 30 comments - peterattiamd on September 3, 2026: "What Brian wants people to know about headaches | Brian Grosberg, M.D.

This clip is from episode # 406 of The Drive which was released on 8/31/26.

In the full episode, we cover:

-Why migraine is a neurologic disease rather than an ordinary headache, and why that distinction changes how it should be understood and treated
-How a migraine unfolds in phases well beyond the pain itself, from the warning signs that can appear a day ahead to the fog that can linger after
-Why cluster headache, among the most painful conditions in medicine, is so often mistaken for a sinus infection or allergies
-Why migraines run so strongly in families and why they affect women roughly three times as often as men
-Much more

Listen (Ep. # 406) to the full episode on my website or your favorite podcast player.".
